title: Ridgley's Tuxedo Band name versus Celestin's
summary: Dejan says there was no confusion between Ridgley's Tuxedo Band and Celestin's Tuxedo Band.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: I was going to ask one more question about Ridgely, did they both call it the Tuxedo Band? Is there any trouble about that? Yeah.

No I never heard no confusion about it. I never heard no confusion about it because I don't think Susie had copyright on it but when Ridgely made his band he called it Ridgely's Tuxedo Band. Yeah. And Celestad Celestad's Tuxedo Band. That's right, that's the name he went on, that's the way he played. Country club or Southern Yacht Club, everywhere. Ridgely's Tuxedo Band. And people liked him very much.
